data.body: chunk12 follow-up (SHA 0f51601b96): The update_one field-allowlist gap that bug 85a1 fixed for issuetype/status had a sibling gap for parent. update_one's _OUTBOUND_BATCH_ALLOWLIST omitted 'parent', so parent-only outbound updates were stripped and set_parent was never invoked on the production batch path (the typed leaf _apply_outbound_update already routed parent correctly, but reconcile_once dispatches outbound via _apply_batch->update_one, not the typed leaf). Fixed by popping parent before the allowlist filter and routing via client.set_parent with a 400 hierarchy guard, mirroring the typed leaf. RED->GREEN test_update_one_parent_routing.py (4). test_update_one_field_filter.py (the 85a1 regression tests) remain green.
